notes.title: New Artwork and Levels in Progress
notes.content:
Hey, gunslingers

We are working on new levels and reworking some artworks to deliver a fresh content to ya!

Thanks for supporting us on Early Access. You are great, guys!

Soon you will have more challenges and enemies to shoot 'em full of holes and fill 'em full of lead.

Hell yeah!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30175542/f42f6df9e8ed139664eca184b5f2317d885be639.png[/img]

notes.title: Tough Story: Big Hell is now on early access
notes.content:
Hey, stranger

We are launching an early access version of Tough Story: Big Hell.

We want to bring the community to join us on the development, so please give any feedback that you can, through the community discussions and we'll talk about.

Thanks everyone and let's shoot the shit out of these bastards with a lot of sound and fury!

Hell yeah!

notes.title: Launch until the end of setember
notes.content:

Cheers.
